fills.researcher_notes: SNGPL's own 'Province-Wise Transmission Breakup' table (as of 30 June 2025) lists, under KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA, 'MARDAN - SWAT', diameter 12 in, MainLine = 104.89 km — an exact match to the sheet's LengthKnown (104.89) AND Diameter (12). Same single-org caveat as the Punjab rows in this cluster, but exact to the hundredth of a km. Recommend no change to LengthKnown; the drawn route (73 km, ratio 0.70, shorter than stated) is the more likely error given the Mardan-Swat corridor crosses hilly terrain via Chakdara, where a schematic straight line would plausibly undershoot the true pipeline distance.

validity.recommendation: Do not merge/drop P5486 as a duplicate of P4181 (Sakhakot-Swat) on length grounds. SNGPL's own current asset register lists 'MARDAN - SWAT' (12in, 104.89km) and 'SAKHAKOT - SWAT' (8in, 68.06km) as two separate named segments with different diameters and different lengths, which is evidence for two distinct physical lines rather than one line double-counted. This is offered as input to the standing duplicate adjudication (per the brief, not being re-litigated here), not as a final call.
validity.researcher_notes: The same KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA table that confirms Mardan-Swat's 104.89km (Sr# in the 40s of that section) separately lists Sr#55 'SAKHAKOT - SWAT', 8in, MainLine = 68.06km, elsewhere in the same table. Both carry SNGPL's own current diameters and lengths, and they differ from each other on both axes, which is the pattern expected for two distinct physical lines feeding Swat from different directions (Mardan via the N-95/Chakdara corridor vs. Sakhakot further west), not a single line captured twice under two names. Flagging as corroborating evidence only.
